facts.fact: The NDPC launched an investigation into Temu's data processing (about 12.7 million Nigerian data subjects) under the NDPA, with no decision reported.
The NDPC states that violators of the Nigeria Data Protection Act face enforcement including fines and sanctions, treating the Act as in force.
The NDPC acts under a National Commissioner and CEO, Vincent Olatunji, who announced the Temu investigation.
